caption: The drawing features two main figures positioned on a green, rectangular base. On the left, there is a large, brown bear standing upright on its hind legs with its front paws raised and mouth open, displaying its teeth. The bear's eyes are wide open, and it stands next to a tree stump. On the right, there is a human figure, dressed in a red long-sleeve shirt with yellow details along the edges, yellow pants with fringe, moccasin-like footwear, and a headdress with feather-like elements. The person is kneeling on their right knee, with the left knee bent and foot flat on the ground. The figure is holding a long rifle, pointing it directly at the bear. The base beneath both figures is textured and painted green to resemble grass. The composition is set against a plain, beige background.
title: Toy Bank: Hunter Shooting Bear
